content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with [product_name] PLCs and am unsure if the outputs are potential free. [article_no]: 24VDC transistor outputs, 0.3A, non-isolated. [article_no]: 230VAC relay outputs, isolated. [article_no]: 230VAC relay outputs, isolated.

Thank you [user_name] for the quick response. I would like to confirm if it is possible to connect 230VAC to the output terminal of [article_no], and 24VDC to the output terminals of [article_no] and [article_no]. Thanks in advance.

A new question has been published by [user_name] in a separate thread with the topic 'Difference between [article_no] and [article_no]'. Best regards [user_name]

They are particularly concerned about whether relay outputs are potential free and if mixed-voltage connections are feasible per output channel.
